content: When the weaver works with devotion, every thread is woven with the name of the Divine; ordinary cloth becomes a sacred garment.
author: Kabir
explanation: Kabir, a humble weaver by trade, showed that every profession can become sacred liturgy when executed with total mindfulness, honesty, and love.
practicalInsight: Approach your work today not as a chore to get through, but as a consecrated craft woven with excellence and joy.
reflectionPrompt: How would the quality of my output change if I treated every task as a sacred offering?
